title: Janovic Same-Day Delivery
summary: Same-day paint and supply delivery for contractors and job sites. Heavy item handling, box trucks with lift gates, branded tracking, and multi-store routing. Trusted by Janovic.
body_markdown:
# Same-Day Delivery Built for Paint & Supply Stores


Contractors are on-site waiting for paint. Getcho gets their order there today -- with the right vehicle for every load. Sedans for touch-up kits, box trucks with lift gates for pallets of 5-gallon buckets. Multi-store routing, branded tracking, and proof of delivery at the job site. Trusted by Janovic paint stores in NYC.
